name: Process Definition Service
description: Stores schemas and rules for process(es), provides validation config, UI bundle, and label configuration.
bounded_context: Owns the definition and publication of process schemas and related configuration artifacts used to validate and render process definitions.
purpose: Centralize storage, versioning, and publication of process schemas and associated configuration such as validation rules, UI bundle metadata, and labels.

internal_components.name: Process Definition API
internal_components.responsibility: Expose endpoints to create, update, retrieve, and publish process definitions; Validate request shape and authorization; Return schema and configuration artifacts to consumers

internal_components.name: Process Definition Application Service
internal_components.responsibility: Coordinate process definition lifecycle operations; Apply validation and publication workflows; Orchestrate persistence and event emission

internal_components.name: Process Definition Domain Model
internal_components.responsibility: Represent process schema, rules, validation config, UI bundle, and label configuration; Enforce domain invariants for versioning and publication readiness

internal_components.name: Process Definition Repository
internal_components.responsibility: Store process schema versions and related configuration artifacts; Support retrieval by process identifier and version

internal_components.name: Process Definition Event Publisher
internal_components.responsibility: Publish process schema lifecycle events; Ensure emitted events reflect committed state

external_integrations: Process definition consumers that retrieve schemas and configuration via API
Event bus for publishing process schema lifecycle events
security_controls: Validate all schema and configuration inputs
observability: Structured logs for create, update, validate, and publish operations
Metrics for request volume, validation failures, and publication outcomes
Tracing across API, application, persistence, and messaging components
notes: No ADRs or guidance documents were provided.
Baseline and extracted current-state definitions are aligned; no unresolved differences were identified.
service_purpose: Centralize storage, versioning, and publication of process schemas and associated configuration such as validation rules, UI bundle metadata, and labels.
